properties.Workflow credit: seitanism — Banodoco MiniMax H3 seamless-extension thread

widgets_values:
H3 SEAMLESS CHAIN — GLOBAL REFS + MOTION CONTEXT 39/39

ACTIVE BY DEFAULT
• Clip 1 = Ref2VA start using GLOBAL CHARACTER REFS
• Clip 2 = Ref2VA + Motion Context continuation

OPTIONAL
• Clip 3 and Clips 4–6 are present but bypassed.
• Use the Fast Groups Bypasser panel to activate them SEQUENTIALLY:
  Clip 3 → Clip 4 → Clip 5 → Clip 6.
• Do not activate Clip 5 unless Clip 4 is active, etc.

GLOBAL CHARACTER REFS
• Select two images in the purple GLOBAL CHARACTER REFS group before queueing.
• Ref 1 = face / identity.
• Ref 2 = full body / wardrobe of the SAME character.
• Both references are wired into every clip as <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>.

MODELS / COMPATIBILITY
• Video model = minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
• Text encoder = qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors
• Requires this H3 Motion Context node pack; multi-ref timeline-audio compatibility is built in.
• Compatibility fix and workflow by seitanism in the Banodoco MiniMax H3 thread.
• Do not run the separately posted V2 patch script with this version.

PREVIEWS
• Each clip uses VHS Video Combine with save_output = false.
• VHS writes preview media only to ComfyUI's temp directory, not output.
• H.264 is used because browser preview is more reliable than H.265.

NO PNG GALLERIES
• No SaveImage nodes are used.
• The chain uses raw IMAGE/AUDIO tensors directly, so PNG files are unnecessary.

FINAL
• The final VHS node concatenates decoded image/audio tensors first,
  then saves ONE H.264 MP4 in output/.

GLOBAL DEFAULTS
• Duration = 15 sec raw H3 target per clip.
• Motion Context overlap = 39 frames (~1.625 sec), so each continuation
  contributes roughly 13.4 sec of NEW footage after trimming.
• Audio timeline context = 39 frames.
• Resolution = 0.5 MP, 16:9, rounded to multiple of 32.

OPTIONAL FULL PREVIOUS AUDIO REF
• A separate red experimental section can feed each previous clip's ENTIRE delivered audio into the next Ref2VA clip.
• Use the 'FULL PREVIOUS AUDIO REF — TOGGLE HERE' Fast Groups Muter button.
• OFF by default.
• WARNING: this can break seamless audio continuation or make music restart/replay. The tested stable configuration is with this option OFF.
nodes.title: READ ME

widgets_values:
The rgthree control is only for convenience.
Niko recommends the Easy/Fast Group Bypasser for Motion Context chains.

Optional groups are BYPASSED by default.
Turn them on from left to right only: Clip 3, then 4, then 5, then 6.

nodes.title: CLIP 1 — START WITH GLOBAL REFS

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the same character defined jointly by <Picture 1> for facial identity and <Picture 2> for full-body appearance, wardrobe, proportions, and distinctive details.

summary:
[reference generation] Continue the existing scene and motion without resetting anything, while keeping <Subject 1> fully consistent with the two character references whenever visible or when re-entering the frame.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1] whenever visible): fully_preserved - preserve facial identity, hair, body proportions, wardrobe, colors, and distinctive features from <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>; do not copy their pose, expression, framing, or background. Match the incoming visual state from the carried motion context and do not visibly re-resolve or beautify the face right at the continuation boundary.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] The existing subject motion, camera trajectory, physical momentum, and ongoing action continue uninterrupted from the preceding clip. Preserve continuity with the incoming visual state, lighting, facial texture, sharpness, and rendering character from the carried motion context. [DESCRIBE WHAT HAPPENS NEXT; DO NOT RESTART FROM REST. If <Subject 1> re-enters after being off-screen, restore the same referenced identity naturally.]

overall_soundscape:
The existing ambience and ongoing sound continue across the join without a fresh start. If the optional full previous-clip audio reference is enabled, use it only as a broad sonic-identity reference; do not replay, restart, or copy its temporal progression. [DESCRIBE NEW SOUND CHANGES CAUSED BY THE CONTINUING ACTION.]

widgets_values:
FINAL JOIN

The final video is assembled from raw decoded IMAGE batches + AUDIO tensors.
No intermediate MP4 is used as source material.

Preview nodes:
save_output = false → temp directory only.

Final node:
save_output = true → output/h3_chain/final/

OPTIONAL CLIPS
If Clip 3/4/5/6 are OFF, their cumulative ImageBatch / AudioConcat nodes are bypassed
and pass the prior cumulative stream forward.

Always activate optional clips sequentially: 3 → 4 → 5 → 6.

CONTEXT SETTINGS
All continuation clips use Motion Context = 39 video frames + 39 timeline-audio frames.
The workflow assumes the V2 multi-ref audio patch remains installed.

EXPERIMENTAL FULL AUDIO REF
The full-previous-audio reference toggle is OFF by default. Turning it ON may make music restart/replay and can introduce an audible seam. The 39/39 Motion Context continuation remains the recommended baseline.
nodes.title: Final output notes
GLOBAL REFERENCE INSTRUCTIONS
widgets_values:
SELECT BOTH IMAGES BEFORE QUEUING.

REF 1 = strongest face / identity image.
REF 2 = full-body / wardrobe / proportions image of the SAME character.

Every clip receives both references as <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>.
This workflow is designed for the installed V2 Motion Context patch and uses 39 video context frames + 39 timeline-audio frames on every continuation.
Ref image size defaults to MATCH for speed. Change per clip to MAX only if you need stronger identity fidelity.

nodes.title: FULL PREVIOUS AUDIO REF — TOGGLE HERE
⚠ DISCLAIMER — FULL AUDIO REF IS EXPERIMENTAL
widgets_values:
OFF BY DEFAULT — ENABLE ONLY FOR EXPERIMENTS.

This feeds the ENTIRE audio of the previous delivered clip into the next Ref2VA clip as an ordinary audio reference.

⚠ In our test this could BREAK AUDIO CONTINUATION: the music restarted/replayed from an earlier point and produced a noticeable seam.

The proven 39-frame timeline-audio continuation remains active regardless. If enabling this makes the join worse, turn this option OFF again.

nodes.title: OPTIONAL AUDIO REF SIGNAL
widgets_values:
OFF: muted Any Switch outputs None → Ref2VA receives no full-audio reference.
ON: each switch passes the previous clip's entire delivered audio into ref_audio_0.
The 39-frame Motion Context timeline-audio path is separate and stays enabled.
